audits.mathematicalReason: Rotating a rectangular region about one side sweeps a disk of constant radius at every height, forming a circular cylinder. The axial side gives its height and the perpendicular side its radius. A right triangle rotated about a leg instead forms a cone, and a semicircular region rotated about its diameter forms a sphere. A straight translation of a parallelogram does not form a circular cylinder. The moving-region interpretation matches cnm_052, while cylinder structure is defensible support under cnm_h106.
